entries.title: II Corinthians 11:1
segments: ¶Oh, that you would bear with me in a little folly--and indeed you do bear with me.

entries.title: II Corinthians 11:2
segments: For I am jealous for you with godly jealousy. For I have betrothed you to one husband, that I may present [you as] a chaste virgin to Christ.

entries.title: II Corinthians 11:3
segments: But I fear, lest somehow, as the serpent deceived Eve by his craftiness, so your minds may be corrupted from the simplicity that is in Christ.

entries.title: II Corinthians 11:4
segments: For if he who comes preaches another Jesus whom we have not preached, or [if] you receive a different spirit which you have not received, or a different gospel which you have not accepted--you may well put up with it!

entries.title: II Corinthians 11:5
segments: ¶For I consider that I am not at all inferior to the most eminent apostles.

entries.title: II Corinthians 11:6
segments: Even though [I am] untrained in speech, yet [I am] not in knowledge. But we have been thoroughly manifested among you in all things.

entries.title: II Corinthians 11:7
segments: Did I commit sin in humbling myself that you might be exalted, because I preached the gospel of God to you free of charge?

entries.title: II Corinthians 11:8
segments: I robbed other churches, taking wages [from them] to minister to you.

entries.title: II Corinthians 11:9
segments: And when I was present with you, and in need, I was a burden to no one, for what I lacked the brethren who came from Macedonia supplied. And in everything I kept myself from being burdensome to you, and so I will keep [myself].

entries.title: II Corinthians 11:10
segments: As the truth of Christ is in me, no one shall stop me from this boasting in the regions of Achaia.

entries.title: II Corinthians 11:11
segments: Why? Because I do not love you? God knows!

entries.title: II Corinthians 11:12
segments: But what I do, I will also continue to do, that I may cut off the opportunity from those who desire an opportunity to be regarded just as we are in the things of which they boast.

entries.title: II Corinthians 11:13
segments: For such [are] false apostles, deceitful workers, transforming themselves into apostles of Christ.

entries.title: II Corinthians 11:14
segments: And no wonder! For Satan himself transforms himself into an angel of light.

entries.title: II Corinthians 11:15
segments: Therefore [it is] no great thing if his ministers also transform themselves into ministers of righteousness, whose end will be according to their works.

entries.title: II Corinthians 11:16
segments: ¶I say again, let no one think me a fool. If otherwise, at least receive me as a fool, that I also may boast a little.

entries.title: II Corinthians 11:17
segments: What I speak, I speak not according to the Lord, but as it were, foolishly, in this confidence of boasting.

entries.title: II Corinthians 11:18
segments: Seeing that many boast according to the flesh, I also will boast.

entries.title: II Corinthians 11:19
segments: For you put up with fools gladly, since you [yourselves] are wise!

entries.title: II Corinthians 11:20
segments: For you put up with it if one brings you into bondage, if one devours [you], if one takes [from you], if one exalts himself, if one strikes you on the face.

entries.title: II Corinthians 11:21
segments: To [our] shame, I say that we were too weak for that! But in whatever anyone is bold--I speak foolishly--I am bold also.

entries.title: II Corinthians 11:22
segments: ¶Are they Hebrews? So [am] I. Are they Israelites? So [am] I. Are they the seed of Abraham? So [am] I.

entries.title: II Corinthians 11:23
segments: Are they ministers of Christ? --I speak as a fool--I [am] more: in labors more abundant, in stripes above measure, in prisons more frequently, in deaths often.

entries.title: II Corinthians 11:24
segments: From the Jews five times I received forty [stripes] minus one.

entries.title: II Corinthians 11:25
segments: Three times I was beaten with rods; once I was stoned; three times I was shipwrecked; a night and a day I have been in the deep;

entries.title: II Corinthians 11:26
segments: [in] journeys often, [in] perils of waters, [in] perils of robbers, [in] perils of [my own] countrymen, [in] perils of the Gentiles, [in] perils in the city, [in] perils in the wilderness, [in] perils in the sea, [in] perils among false brethren;

entries.title: II Corinthians 11:27
segments: in weariness and toil, in sleeplessness often, in hunger and thirst, in fastings often, in cold and nakedness--

entries.title: II Corinthians 11:28
segments: besides the other things, what comes upon me daily: my deep concern for all the churches.

entries.title: II Corinthians 11:29
segments: Who is weak, and I am not weak? Who is made to stumble, and I do not burn with indignation?

entries.title: II Corinthians 11:30
segments: If I must boast, I will boast in the things which concern my infirmity.

entries.title: II Corinthians 11:31
segments: The God and Father of our Lord Jesus Christ, who is blessed forever, knows that I am not lying.

entries.title: II Corinthians 11:32
segments: In Damascus the governor, under Aretas the king, was guarding the city of the Damascenes with a garrison, desiring to arrest me;

entries.title: II Corinthians 11:33
segments: but I was let down in a basket through a window in the wall, and escaped from his hands.
